"HONEY EMPIRE – COMPLETE ROBLOX SIMULATOR GAME

Create a polished, addictive Roblox-style incremental simulator called HONEY EMPIRE.

The game revolves around collecting bees, producing honey, filling collectible jars, purchasing upgrades, unlocking new worlds and building the ultimate honey empire.

The game should feel like a high-quality Roblox simulator with satisfying animations, rewarding progression, colorful environments and a well-designed economy.

1. CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP

The main gameplay loop is:

Collect pollen → Bees produce honey → Fill honey jars → Sell jars → Earn coins → Purchase upgrades → Unlock better bees → Unlock new worlds → Rebirth.

Make the gameplay satisfying and rewarding at every stage.

2. BEE SYSTEM

Create a collection system with multiple bee rarities:

- Common
- Uncommon
- Rare
- Epic
- Legendary
- Mythical
- Divine
- Secret

Every bee must have unique:

- Appearance and animations.
- Honey production speed.
- Pollen collection speed.
- Carrying capacity.
- Movement speed.
- Special abilities.

Bees should automatically fly between flowers and beehives.

Add an egg hatching system with different egg types, rarity probabilities and exclusive bees for each world.

Add a bee fusion system where players can combine 3 identical bees to create a stronger version.

3. HONEY PRODUCTION

Create an automated honey production system.

Bees collect pollen from flowers and return to their hive to convert pollen into honey.

Different flowers produce different types of honey.

Display real-time honey production statistics.

Allow players to upgrade production speed, pollen capacity, bee efficiency and honey multipliers.

4. HONEY JAR SYSTEM – IMPORTANT

This must be one of the most visually satisfying mechanics in the entire game.

Players have collectible honey jars with different capacities, designs and special bonuses.

When a jar fills up:

1. Display a beautiful jar-filling animation.
2. Show golden honey physically pouring into the jar.
3. The honey level must visibly rise inside the transparent jar.
4. Add realistic dripping effects, bubbles and reflections.
5. Play satisfying pouring sound effects.
6. When full, close the jar with a lid.
7. Make the jar glow briefly.
8. Display the amount of honey collected.
9. Allow the player to sell the jar and receive rewards.

The honey pouring animation must be smooth and visually appealing.

Do not replace this mechanic with a simple progress bar.

5. UPGRADE TREE

Create a large interactive upgrade tree with four separate branches:

HONEY PRODUCTION

- Honey per second.
- Honey multipliers.
- Pollen conversion efficiency.
- Critical production chance.

BEE EFFICIENCY

- Bee flying speed.
- Pollen collection speed.
- Maximum bee capacity.
- Number of active bees.

JAR TECHNOLOGY

- Jar capacity.
- Filling speed.
- Multiple active jars.
- Selling price bonuses.

ROYAL RESEARCH

- Better egg luck.
- Rare bee probabilities.
- Permanent multipliers.
- Rebirth bonuses.

Use interconnected nodes, unlock requirements, upgrade levels, prices and visually distinct purchased/unlocked/locked states.

6. WORLDS

Create five unique explorable worlds:

1. STARTER MEADOW – beginner flowers, worker bees and basic honey.
2. DESERT ISLAND – cactus flowers, desert bees and golden sand jars.
3. FROZEN KINGDOM – ice bees, frozen honey and crystal jars.
4. ENCHANTED FOREST – magical flowers, fairy bees and emerald jars.
5. COSMIC GALAXY – celestial bees, stardust honey and cosmic jars.

Every world must have unique environmental assets, music, flowers, bees, eggs, jars and exclusive upgrades.

Require players to reach specific honey and progression milestones before unlocking new worlds.

7. REBIRTH SYSTEM

Allow players to reset their normal progression in exchange for permanent rewards.

Create:

- Rebirth tokens.
- Permanent honey multipliers.
- Exclusive royal bees.
- Rebirth-only upgrades.
- Special cosmetics.
- Rebirth milestones.

Add a separate Royal Rebirth Upgrade Tree.

8. ADDITIONAL FEATURES

Include:

- Daily rewards.
- Daily quests.
- Achievements.
- Golden Honey Rush events.
- Rare random bee mutations.
- Boss events.
- Bee trading.
- Player leaderboards.
- Secret eggs.
- Hidden areas.
- Exclusive collectibles.
- Offline honey production with balanced limits.

9. USER INTERFACE

Create a professional, colorful and polished simulator interface.

Include:

- Honey balance.
- Coin balance.
- Current jar capacity and filling progress.
- Bee inventory.
- Egg shop.
- Upgrade tree.
- World selection.
- Rebirth menu.
- Quest menu.
- Settings.

Use a golden honey-themed design with rounded buttons, smooth transitions, readable text and attractive icons.

The interface must work on PC, mobile and tablet.

10. VISUAL QUALITY

Use a colorful, cute, polished 3D Roblox-inspired art style.

Create:

- Detailed animated bees.
- Beautiful flowers.
- Realistic-looking honey.
- Transparent glass jars.
- Smooth particle effects.
- Satisfying animations.
- Colorful environments.
- Dynamic lighting.

Make the bees visibly fly around the player rather than simply displaying static icons.

11. PROGRESSION AND BALANCING

Make the early game rewarding and fast-paced.

Gradually increase upgrade costs and progression requirements.

Every new world should introduce meaningful improvements.

Avoid making progression excessively slow or requiring constant repetitive clicking.

Make the game enjoyable both for active players and players who prefer idle progression.

12. DEVELOPMENT PRIORITIES

Build the game in stages.

FIRST PRIORITY:

- Functional bee movement.
- Automatic pollen collection.
- Honey production.
- Working jar-filling mechanics.
- Animated honey pouring.
- Selling filled jars.
- Basic upgrades.
- Functional UI.

SECOND PRIORITY:

- Bee rarity and hatching.
- Upgrade tree.
- Multiple jars.
- World unlocking.
- Rebirth system.

THIRD PRIORITY:

- Trading.
- Bosses.
- Events.
- Mutations.
- Advanced progression.

Start by creating a fully playable prototype with the first world, 5 bee types, 3 jars, a functional upgrade tree and 10 progression milestones.

IMPORTANT: All buttons, menus, upgrades, animations, currencies and gameplay mechanics must actually work. Do not create decorative buttons that have no functionality.

Prioritize a fully functional game over a visually impressive but non-functional prototype. 8. WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS GAME DIFFERENT FROM OTHER ROBLOX SIMULATORS?

I would introduce a unique system called Honey Mastery.

Every type of honey has its own mastery progression. The more honey you produce in a specific world, the more exclusive rewards and permanent bonuses you unlock for that world.

For example:

* 10,000 Desert Honey → Desert Bee production bonus.

* 100,000 Desert Honey → Desert Jar upgrade.

* 1,000,000 Desert Honey → Exclusive Desert Bee.

* 10,000,000 Desert Honey → Secret Desert Hive.

This gives players a reason to revisit older worlds even after unlocking new ones.

Additional unique features:

* Golden Honey Rush: A random event where all flowers turn golden for 60 seconds, making bees produce 3x more honey.

* Queen Bee Boss: A giant boss that players can fight together to earn exclusive rewards.

* Bee Mutations: Bees can randomly hatch with special mutations such as Rainbow, Shiny, Diamond, Shadow or Golden, giving them unique appearances and stat bonuses.

* Trading System: Players can trade rare bees, exclusive jars and collectibles.

* Secret Areas: Hidden locations in every world containing exclusive eggs, rare flowers and secret bees.

### FINAL RECOMMENDATION

I would build the entire game around three main features that make it addictive and memorable:

1\. The Honey Animation

Make filling the jars extremely satisfying. Honey should physically drizzle into transparent jars, gradually rise, create bubbles and produce beautiful visual effects.

2\. The Bee Collection System

Players should always have a new, stronger or rarer bee to chase. Introduce exclusive bees, mutations, fusion and different abilities.

3\. The Upgrade Tree

Create deep progression with meaningful choices. Players should be able to specialize in honey production, bee efficiency, jar technology or royal research.

My biggest advice: Don't release all five worlds immediately. Build the first world perfectly, test the economy, make sure every mechanic works, and then gradually expand the game.

Your goal should be to create a game where someone joins for 5 minutes but ends up playing for 45 minutes because they want to unlock just one more upgrade, hatch one more egg or discover one more rare bee.

Make progression addictive, animations satisfying and every new unlock feel rewarding.


---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
